note: Agave prompt library. Prompts are Agave's own words. Each card shows the shape of what the entry makes.

items.title: Creator portrait
items.blurb: A believable base portrait for a new creator. Save it as an Element to keep the face.
items.prompt: Eye-level portrait of a 27-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark curly hair and light freckles, sitting at a wooden desk in a small sunlit home studio, hands resting on the desk, looking into the lens with a relaxed half smile. Soft window light from the left, a warm lamp glowing behind her, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field. Natural skin texture with visible pores, no beauty filter, no microphones, cameras or lights in the frame.

items.title: Same person, four poses
items.blurb: One picture in, a 2x2 grid of the same person out. Pick a panel to keep going.
items.needs_ref: Add a portrait of the person (or press Use on one you made).

items.title: Change the outfit only
items.blurb: Same face, pose and room. Only the clothes change.
items.needs_ref: Add the picture of the person first.

items.title: Character sheet
items.blurb: Front, back and face on flat gray, ready to save as an Element.
items.needs_ref: Add the picture of the character first.

items.title: Your product, new scene
items.blurb: Put the exact product somewhere new without changing it.
items.needs_ref: Add a photo of your product (or save it as an Element and type its @tag).
items.prompt: Place this exact product on a black marble counter at night with soft neon reflections behind it. Keep its shape, colours and details the same.

items.title: Studio hero shot
items.blurb: A clean listing or ad shot with space for a headline.
items.needs_ref: Add a photo of your product.
items.prompt: Studio hero shot of this exact product on a matte stone pedestal, seamless warm gray backdrop, one soft key light from above left and a subtle rim light, centered with clear space above for text. Keep the product unchanged.

items.title: Nine angles
items.blurb: A 3x3 sheet of the product on light gray. Check that the angles really differ before using it for 3D.
items.needs_ref: Add a photo of your product.

items.title: Editorial food photo
items.blurb: Overhead, soft morning light. Cheap and fast on Flux Schnell.
items.prompt: Overhead photo of a rustic sourdough loaf on a floured linen cloth, a butter knife and a small dish of salted butter beside it, soft morning window light, natural shadows, editorial food photography.

items.title: Film still
items.blurb: A wide, moody frame to animate into an opening shot.
items.prompt: Wide cinematic still of a vintage motorcycle parked outside a lonely roadside diner at dusk, a red neon sign reading "DINER" just flickering on, long shadows across the gravel, anamorphic 35mm lens, soft haze, light film grain, low camera angle.

items.title: Thumbnail background
items.blurb: High-contrast scene with the left third left empty for your face and title.
items.prompt: Bold YouTube thumbnail background, full-bleed and filling the whole frame edge to edge with no black bars or borders: a busy maker workbench with a glowing 3D printer on the right, strong orange key light against deep teal shadows, shallow depth of field, clean empty space on the left third for a face and big text, high contrast, no text, no logos.

items.title: Bring a still to life
items.blurb: Gentle motion from a still you approved. Picture first, then video.
items.needs_ref: Start from a still: press Animate on a picture you made, or add one.
items.prompt: Slow push-in. The subject moves naturally, small shifts of weight, cloth and hair moving in a light breeze. Steady exposure, no cuts.

items.title: 3D model from photos
items.blurb: 1 to 4 photos of one object become a model to spin, print (STL, 3MF) or view in AR.
items.needs_ref: Add 1 to 4 photos of the object: front, side, back.
